gloss: frequency; number of times; alcohol content; lens prescription

definitions.explanation: The number of occurrences or repetitions of something. A count of how many times an event has happened.
The percentage of alcohol in a beverage. Commonly referred to as アルコール度数.
The strength of corrective lenses for glasses or contact lenses, measured in diopters.

examples.japanese: {利用|りよう}{度数|どすう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check the number of uses.

examples.japanese: {通話|つうわ}{度数|どすう}が{残|のこ}り{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: I have few call units remaining.

examples.japanese: {度数|どすう}の{高|たか}い{統計|とうけい}データを{分析|ぶんせき}した。
examples.english: I analyzed statistical data with high frequency.

examples.japanese: アルコール{度数|どすう}は{何|なん}パーセント？
この{日本酒|にほんしゅ}は{度数|どすう}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This sake has a high alcohol content.

examples.japanese: {度数|どすう}の{低|ひく}いお{酒|さけ}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose a drink with low alcohol content.

examples.japanese: {眼鏡|めがね}の{度数|どすう}が{合|あ}わない。
{度数|どすう}を{上|あ}げてもらった。
examples.english: I had them increase my lens prescription.

examples.japanese: {視力|しりょく}が{落|お}ちたので、{度数|どすう}の{強|つよ}いレンズに{変|か}えた。
examples.english: My eyesight got worse, so I switched to stronger lenses.

notes:
Compound of {度|ど} (degree, time) and {数|すう} (number, count). The word spans several domains, but the most common everyday uses are for alcohol content and eyeglass prescriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アルコール{度数|どすう} — alcohol content/percentage
- {度数|どすう}が{高|たか}い — high in content/frequency
- {度数|どすう}が{低|ひく}い — low in content/frequency
- {眼鏡|めがね}の{度数|どすう} — glasses prescription strength
- {度数|どすう}を{上|あ}げる — to increase the strength/frequency

RELATED TERMS:
- {度|ど} — degree; a more general unit of measurement
- {頻度|ひんど} — frequency; more commonly used for how often something occurs
- {濃度|のうど} — concentration; density (of a solution)
- {視力|しりょく} — eyesight; vision
